description: This file defines an abstract class 'ModelForm' which models a form widget in the Apache OFBiz framework. It constructs its data structure based on XML element input, capturing form configuration, fields, actions, styling, and related components. The class is designed to be immutable and thread-safe, representing the configuration of form elements such as fields, sorting, pagination, and behaviors in the framework's widget system.

classes.name: ModelForm
classes.description: An abstract class representing form widgets in OFBiz, encapsulating configuration, layout, fields, actions, pagination, sorting, and styling. It is constructed from an XML element and designed for thread-safe, immutable usage. It supports property expansion, dynamic fields, and nested components, serving as a core part of the OFBiz widget model system.
